name: Silk Drape
description: The subject rests in the sculptural folds of a length of richly saturated silk fabric, professionally lit to reveal real fold shadows and fabric sheen. Genuine physical set design — the kind of flowing-fabric backdrop real fragrance and jewelry campaigns actually shoot, not a digital effect.
lighting: Soft raking key, real fabric sheen and fold shadow
subject: product
prompt: a pendant necklace resting in the sculptural folds of a length of richly saturated deep-emerald silk fabric, the fabric draped and gathered into genuine three-dimensional folds rather than lying flat, one soft raking key light crossing the silk to reveal real fold shadows and a true woven-silk sheen along the fabric's high points, the necklace's polished metal catching a distinct highlight against the fabric's own softer sheen, shallow depth of field keeping the necklace and its immediate fold crisp while the wider drape softens toward the edges of frame, one dominant saturated silk color throughout, no second product, no props beyond the fabric, immaculate commercial-render clarity
